entries.title: Documentation
entries.summary: Supporting documentation organized into decisions/, modules/, and superpowers/ subdirectories. Contains architectural decisions, module documentation, and superpowers reference material.

entries.title: OpenSpec Framework
entries.summary: Specification-driven development framework with changes/, specs/, and schemas/ directories. Uses an artifact workflow (proposal → design → specs → tasks → verify). All changes are in archived state.

entries.title: Planning Documents
entries.summary: Planning workspace containing openspec-memory-sync-v2.md and question01.md. Lightweight planning directory separate from OpenSpec change artifacts.

entries.title: Skills Collection
entries.summary: Core skill definitions organized by prefix taxonomy. 14 skills across qa-, research-, sdlc-, transform-, study-, media-, integration-, ops-, and meta-skill- categories. Each skill has SKILL.md, optional scripts/, schemas/, templates/, references/.

entries.title: Test Suite
entries.summary: Python test suite covering skill lifecycle, module discovery, OCR router, and repository memory (init/load/sync). Uses pytest-style tests with supporting test images and markdown fixtures.
